visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Sort from high to low with a compare function
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The numbers are sorted low to high and then reversed in a second step. Swap the compare function so one sort puts them high to low. The result must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Returning b - a instead of a - b reverses the order in the same pass. Two steps become one, and the intent is in the compare function.

checks.label: The points run from high to low
